SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.hint: The optional rules from the core rulebook (p.111), and Hard Luck from the Western Reaches (GMWR p.30). Every rule switches on by itself, so you can run one rule of a mode without the rest.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.label: Modes of Play
SDE.settings.dyingHiddenTimer.name: Hidden death timers
SDE.settings.dyingHiddenTimer.hint: An option of the core dying rule, with or without Deadly: the GM's client rolls each death timer out of sight. Players see that a character is dying but not how many rounds are left; the GM sees the count.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.deadlyHint: Core rulebook p.111. Dying itself (p.89) runs whether or not a mode is on, except while Shadowdark Crawl Helper is active.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.grinderHint: Core rulebook p.111. Grinder takes effect in Shadowdark Extras' camping rest, so its switches are Extras' own settings.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.grinderNeed: Grinder Mode changes how a rest heals, and the only rest in Foundry is Shadowdark Extras' camping rest. Install a version of Shadowdark Extras with Grinder Mode to switch it on here.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.momentumHin: Core rulebook p.111. Exploding damage is the Shadowdark system's own setting, shown here.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.momentumRep: Advantage on repeating an action that just failed is granted at the table; nothing here tracks it.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.pulpHint: Core rulebook p.111. No maximum on luck tokens is the Shadowdark system's own setting, shown here.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.pulpExtraAc: Spending a luck token for an extra action: spend it from the crawl strip's luck pill, which posts the spend to chat.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.systemMissi: This rule is a setting of the Shadowdark system, and the installed version of the system doesn't have it.
SDE.settings.modesOfPlayMenu.hardLuckHin: Game Master's Guide to the Western Reaches p.30.
SDE.settings.modeBlitzLights.name: Light sources last 30 minutes
SDE.settings.modeBlitzLights.hint: A torch, a lantern or a light spell lasts 30 minutes instead of an hour.
SDE.settings.modeChaosInitiative.name: Reroll initiative every round
SDE.settings.modeChaosInitiative.hint: At the start of every round after the first, everyone rolls initiative again and the turn order is rebuilt.
SDE.settings.modeChaosDiceSoNice.name: Show Dice So Nice for Chaos rerolls
SDE.settings.modeChaosDiceSoNice.hint: Roll the 3D dice for every round's initiative reroll. Off by default: dice for the whole tracker every round get tiresome. The order is posted either way.
SDE.settings.modeDeadlyTimer.name: Death timers are always 1
SDE.settings.modeDeadlyTimer.hint: A dying character has 1 round to live, whatever their Constitution, class or training.
SDE.settings.modeDeadlyStabilize.name: Stabilizing is DC 18
SDE.settings.modeDeadlyStabilize.hint: Stabilizing a dying character is an Intelligence check at DC 18 instead of DC 15. A helper with a stabilize DC of their own (Heath Witch training) keeps it.
SDE.settings.modeFatality.name: Characters die at 0 HP
SDE.settings.modeFatality.hint: There is no dying: a character reduced to 0 HP is dead.
SDE.settings.modeHunterXp.name: XP for defeated monsters
SDE.settings.modeHunterXp.hint: When a combat ends, every character in it gets XP for each defeated monster: half its level, rounded down, and 1 for a level 1 monster.
SDE.settings.modePulpSessionLuck.name: 1d4 luck at the start of each session
SDE.settings.modePulpSessionLuck.hint: Starting a session sets each party member's luck tokens to 1d4.
SDE.settings.modePulpLuckCrit.name: Spend luck to turn a hit into a critical hit
SDE.settings.modePulpLuckCrit.hint: After an attack hits, its owner can spend a luck token to make it a critical hit.
SDE.settings.modePulpForceReroll.name: Spend luck to make the GM reroll
SDE.settings.modePulpForceReroll.hint: A player can spend a luck token to make the GM reroll a roll the player can see.
SDE.settings.modeHardLuckEffects.name: No luck rerolls with luck-granting effects
SDE.settings.modeHardLuckEffects.hint: Luck can't reroll a roll made with an effect that grants luck itself: Bless, Inspire, Trance or a Seer's Omen.
SDE.settingsGroup.pending: Not automated yet: the choice is saved, but nothing acts on it until a later update.
SDE.settings.spellMishapAutoRoll.name: Auto-roll spell mishap tables
SDE.settings.spellMishapAutoRoll.hint: A natural 1 on a spellcasting check rolls the mishap table for you.
SDE.settings.scavengerAutomate.name: Automate the Delver's Scavenger
SDE.settings.scavengerAutomate.hint: Using up a consumable rolls the Delver's d6 and hands the item back on a success.
SDE.settings.scavengerWatchAmmo.name: Scavenger covers ammunition
SDE.settings.scavengerWatchAmmo.hint: Firing your last arrow or bolt also triggers Scavenger.
SDE.settings.parryAutomate.name: Automate the Duelist's Parry
SDE.settings.parryAutomate.hint: When an attack hits a Duelist, a Parry button on the card turns it into a miss and refunds the damage.
SDE.parry.checkHp: Damage had already been applied — check their HP.
SDE.parry.unknownDamage: {name} parried, but this card's damage was applied before the parry could be tracked — check their HP by hand.
SDE.parry.error.inFlight: That parry is already being resolved.
SDE.parry.error.notTarget: That attack wasn't aimed at your character.
SDE.parry.error.noAbility: That character has no Parry ability.
SDE.parry.error.lost: That ability is spent until you rest.
SDE.settings.tauntAutomate.name: Automate the Duelist's Taunt
SDE.settings.tauntAutomate.hint: An enemy that misses a Duelist gives them advantage against it until their next turn ends.
SDE.taunt.armed: {name} has advantage against {enemy} until the end of their next turn.
SDE.taunt.cancelled: Taunt: advantage against {enemy}, cancelled by disadvantage.
SDE.settings.renownOnCreate.name: Starting renown from CHA
SDE.settings.renownOnCreate.hint: New characters start with renown equal to their Charisma modifier.
SDE.settings.renownOnLevelUp.name: Renown on level-up
SDE.settings.renownOnLevelUp.hint: Characters gain 1 renown each time they level up.
SDE.settings.itemDropsEnabled.name: Item Drops
SDE.settings.itemDropsEnabled.hint: Let players drag items from a sheet onto the map as a pickup token.

SDE.hexMap.tip.clear: Remove every tag and the anchor from this scene

SDE.hexMap.tip.coast: Land touching the sea, a lake or a river tile. Marked for you when the map is classified, and sent to Shadowdark Extras as a feature.
SDE.hexMap.sheet.leaveAlone: Leaving a hex alone says the classifier got it right.

SDE.hexMap.learn.title: Start from a map you have already done
SDE.hexMap.learn.hint: Every hex you tagged yourself there is copied here as a hand tag, and becomes an example for Classify. Hexes you have already tagged here are left alone. Hexes are matched by their printed number, so this is for another go at the same print — on a different map the numbers mean something else.
SDE.hexMap.suspect.title: A card may be named wrong
SDE.hexMap.suspect.lead: These cards do not look like the other cards you gave the same name to — each one looks more like a card you named something else:
SDE.hexMap.suspect.row: the card of {size} hexes you called {name} looks {times}× more like {looksLike}
SDE.hexMap.suspect.why: Naming a card is one answer for every hex in it, so one wrong name is hundreds of wrong hexes. Go back and look at its pictures, or apply anyway if you are sure.
SDE.hexMap.unnamed.title: Cards left unnamed
SDE.hexMap.unnamed.one: {cards} card is unnamed, covering {hexes} hexes (the largest is {largest}).
SDE.hexMap.unnamed.many: {cards} cards are unnamed, covering {hexes} hexes (the largest is {largest}).
SDE.hexMap.unnamed.why: Unnamed hexes are not left alone: they are guessed from the cards you did name, so a card that is its own thing — a river with no terrain under it, a band of ice — comes back as whatever looks nearest. Name it, or say it is a keyed location, unless you mean the classifier to guess.

SDE.importer.source.label: Source
SDE.importer.tools.sourcePdfsTip: Upload your own PDFs of the Shadowdark books. Each is linked to a source so the Open-PDF buttons jump to the cited page. Files stay in your world.
SDE.importer.tools.extractSub: Pull a page's text into the box
SDE.importer.tools.extractTip: Pull clean, reading-ordered text out of one of your uploaded books (any page or range) straight into the paste box.
SDE.importer.tools.exportSub: Back up the whole suite to a file
SDE.importer.tools.exportTip: Download all imported content (every Shadowdark Enhancer compendium pack) as one JSON bundle.
SDE.importer.tools.importBundleSub: Restore a suite from a file
SDE.importer.tools.importBundleTip: Import a bundle file into this world's compendium packs. Existing documents are never overwritten.
SDE.importer.tools.hexMapSub: Upload a map, get an aligned scene
SDE.importer.tools.hexMapTip: Pick a hex-map image: the grid is found on its own, the scene is created aligned, and the tagger opens ready.
SDE.importer.tools.hexTaggerTip: Tag the terrain of every hex on the active hex-map scene from a contact sheet, then hand the dataset to Shadowdark Extras or download it. Reads your own map image in the browser; nothing ships with the module.
SDE.importer.tools.keyLocationsSub: A book's whole hex key, region by region
SDE.importer.tools.keyLocationsTip: Read every keyed location of a book out of your own PDF and file it as journal pages: one entry per region, one page per hex, with the region's summary table alongside. Safe to run again — pages you already have are updated, not duplicated.
SDE.importer.tools.chapterSub: Any page range as a readable journal
SDE.importer.tools.chapterTip: Read a range of pages out of your own PDF and file it as one journal, split into pages at the book's headings, with paragraphs rejoined and page numbers dropped. Has a ready-made preset for the Western Reaches City-States. Safe to run again: the journal is updated in place and pages you added are kept.
SDE.importer.note.offline: Parsing is offline — nothing is uploaded. Auto-detect sorts a mixed dump; pick a specific type to force it (the box shows an example of that type's format). Fields the parser wasn't sure about are highlighted.

SDE.importer.downtime.pasteFrom: Paste the downtime pages from your own copy of {book}
SDE.importer.downtime.thenParse: , then Parse. The outcome text is stored in this world only. Switching books clears the parse — pick the book first.
